[[File:Respawn Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Respawn Teleport''' teleports the caster to their [[respawn point]], which can either be in [[Lumbridge]], [[Falador]], [[Camelot]], [[Edgeville]], [[Prifddinas]], [[Ferox Enclave]], [[Kourend Castle]], or [[Civitas illa Fortis]]. In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]].

The [[defence skillcape]]'s effect does not count as a spawn location; because of this, Respawn Teleport will take the player to their standard respawn location and not [[Ardougne]].
